payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linearly scans integers upward from a+1 until one contains digit '8', returning the number of steps taken.
payload.rationale: Solution linearly scans integers from a+1 until digit '8' appears. No backtracking. Among provided subtypes, search_backtracking is the most generic exhaustive search; others (bitmask, permutation, graph, branch-bound) are mismatched.
